arxiv-2001-04358.title: DoF Region of the Decentralized MIMO Broadcast Channel—How many informed antennas do we need? The work of P. de Kerret and D. Gesbert was supported by ERC under Grant 670896. The collaboration with Syed A. Jafar and Arash G. Davoodi was carried out during the research visit of Antonio Bazco-Nogueras
arxiv-2001-04358.creator: Antonio Bazco-Nogueras 1 3 , Arash Davoodi 2 , Paul de Kerret 1 , David Gesbert 1 , Nicolas Gresset 3 and Syed Jafar 4
arxiv-2001-04358.description: Abstract In this work, we study the impact of imperfect sharing of the Channel State Information (CSI) available at the transmitters on a Network MIMO setting in which a set of M M transmit antennas, possibly not co-located, jointly serve two multi-antenna users endowed with N 1 N_{1} and N 2 N_{2} antennas, respectively.

arxiv-2204-00490.title: Time evolution of quantum correlations in presence of state dependent bath
arxiv-2204-00490.creator: Mehboob Rashid 1, Muzaffar Qadir Lone 2, Prince A Ganai 1
arxiv-2204-00490.description: Abstract The emerging quantum technologies heavily rely on the understanding of dynamics in open quantum systems. In the Born approximation, the initial system-bath correlations are often neglected which can be violated in the strong coupling regimes and quantum state preparation.

arxiv-2209-07133.title: COOL-MC: A Comprehensive Tool for Reinforcement Learning and Model Checking Thanks: Download it from https://zenodo.org/record/6948517#.Yvff-OxBxhE
arxiv-2209-07133.creator: Dennis Gross, Nils Jansen, Sebastian Junges, Guillermo A. Pérez
arxiv-2209-07133.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dennis Gross, Nils Jansen, Sebastian Junges, Guillermo A. Pérez. This paper presents COOL-MC, a tool that integrates state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) and model checking. Specifically, the tool builds upon the OpenAI gym and the probabilistic model checker Storm.

arxiv-2308-01427.title: Differential Evolution VQE for Crypto-currency Arbitrage. Quantum Optimization with many local minima.
arxiv-2308-01427.creator: Gines Carrascal, Beatriz Roman, Guillermo Botella, Alberto del Barrio
arxiv-2308-01427.description: Abstract Crypto-currency markets are known to exhibit inefficiencies, which presents opportunities for profitable cyclic transactions or arbitrage, where one currency is traded for another in a way that results in a net gain without incurring any risk. Quantum computing has shown promise in financial applications, particularly in resolving optimization problems like arbitrage.

arxiv-2412-13875.title: Denoising Nearest Neighbor Graph via Continuous CRF for Visual Re-ranking without Fine-tuning
arxiv-2412-13875.creator: Jaeyoon Kim, Yoonki Cho, Taeyong Kim, Sung-Eui Yoon
arxiv-2412-13875.description: Abstract Visual re-ranking using Nearest Neighbor graph (NN graph) has been adapted to yield high retrieval accuracy, since it is beneficial to exploring an high-dimensional manifold and applicable without additional fine-tuning. The quality of visual re-ranking using NN graph, however, is limited to that of connectivity, i.e., edges of the NN graph. Some edges can be misconnected with negative images.

arxiv-2412-18791.title: Protective Perturbations against Unauthorized Data Usage in Diffusion-based Image Generation Thanks: The authors acknowledge the financial support of this work by the Hong Kong RGC Research Impact Fund grant with Ref. No. R1012-21.
arxiv-2412-18791.creator: 1 st Sen Peng, 2 nd Jijia Yang, 3 rd Mingyue Wang, 4 th Jianfei He, 5 th Xiaohua Jia
arxiv-2412-18791.description: Abstract Diffusion-based text-to-image models have shown immense potential for various image-related tasks. However, despite their prominence and popularity, customizing these models using unauthorized data also brings serious privacy and intellectual property issues. Existing methods introduce protective perturbations based on adversarial attacks, which are applied to the customization samples.

arxiv-2507-22388.title: An equality for balanced digraphs
arxiv-2507-22388.creator: Darij Grinberg, Benjamin Liber
arxiv-2507-22388.description: Abstract Consider a directed multigraph D D that is balanced (i.e., at each vertex, the indegree equals the outdegree). Let A A be its set of arcs. Fix an integer k k . Let s s be a vertex of D D .

arxiv-2509-23675.title: PAT-Agent: Autoformalization for Model Checking
arxiv-2509-23675.creator: Xinyue Zuo, Yifan Zhang, Hongshu Wang, Yufan Cai 1, Zhe Hou, Jing Sun, Jin Song Dong
arxiv-2509-23675.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for automating formal methods. However, applying them to formal verification remains challenging due to the complexity of specification languages, the risk of hallucinated output, and the semantic gap between natural language and formal logic.

arxiv-2509-24991.title: Sampling Complexity of TD and PPO in RKHS
arxiv-2509-24991.creator: Wendi Ren, Weizhong Zhang, Liang Ding, Shuang Li
arxiv-2509-24991.description: Abstract We revisit Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) from a function-space perspective. Our analysis decouples policy evaluation and improvement in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS): (i) A kernelized temporal-difference (TD) critic performs efficient RKHS-gradient updates using only one-step state–action transition samples. (ii) a KL-regularized, natural-gradient policy step exponentiates the evaluated action-value, recovering a PPO/TRPO-style proximal update in continuous state-action spaces.

pmc-10647288.creator: Ryota Nagasaki, Keiji Nagano, Takashi Nezu, Masahiro Iijima, Nikolaos Silikas, Victor Pinheiro Feitosa
pmc-10647288.description: Background: We investigated the effect of bioactive glass and zinc oxide nanoparticles on enamel remineralization, as well as their antimicrobial effect on cariogenic microbes. pmc-11409429.title: A Rare Case of Granulicatella adiacens Gallbladder Abscess Associated With Gallbladder Adenocarcinoma: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenges
pmc-11409429.creator: Heather L Mateja, Ruben Neris, Pablo Giuseppucci
pmc-11409429.description: Granulicatella adiacens, a nutritionally variant streptococcus, is part of the normal oral, gastrointestinal, and urogenital flora. It is associated with bacteremia, infectious endocarditis, and, rarely, bone and joint infections. G. adiacens infections also tend to have high mortality due to diagnostic challenges and antibiotic resistance. Few case reports have documented its role in abscess formation.

pmc-11619938.title: Celebrating Diversity: Unveiling the Characteristics of Nail Psoriasis and Nail Lichen Planus in 30 Patients With Skin of Color
pmc-11619938.creator: Stephano Cedirian, Michela Starace, Alessio Natale, Federico Quadrelli, Kaya L. Curtis, Shari Lipner, Bianca Maria Piraccini
pmc-11619938.description: IntroductionDermatological conditions affecting the nails can manifest differently in individuals with distinct skin tones. This often leads to difficulty in the recognition of nail diseases, especially in people with skin of color (SoC), who are not well represented in the literature.

pmc-12845260.title: Seroprevalence of Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika Viruses Among Febrile Patients in Dhaka, Bangladesh: A Hospital-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12845260.creator: Abir Dutta, Kazi Istiaque Sanin, Azizur Rahman Sharaque, Mahbub Elahi, Bharati Rani Roy, Md. Khaledul Hasan, Md. Sajjadur Rahman, Md. Shakil Ahamed, Mohammad Enayet Hossain, Md. Shafiqul Islam, Nuzhat Nadia, Goutam Kumar Dutta, Mohammed Ziaur Rahman, Md. Nasir Ahmed Khan, Md. Nazmul Islam, Fahmida T
pmc-12845260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Dengue (DENV), Chikungunya (CHIKV), and Zika (ZIKV) are emerging arboviral threats in Bangladesh, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes thriving in urban Dhaka. Overlapping symptoms complicate diagnosis, and Bangladesh-specific data on arboviral antibody reactivity are limited. In four hospitals of Dhaka, we conducted a cross-sectional study on 438 febrile patients aged ≥10 years, collecting samples between September and December 2023 to describe arboviral antibody reactivity and their distribution across selected demographic and environmental characteristics.

pmc-13169725.title: Integrated genomic and transcriptomic analysis reveals candidate genes underlying herbicide resistance in Sorghum
pmc-13169725.creator: Zhichao Xing, Zhengxiao Cheng, Xiaochun Yang, Lu Hu, Kai Wang, Yongfei Wang, Die Hu, Yi-Hong Wang, Junli Du, Lihua Wang, Jieqin Li
pmc-13169725.description: BackgroundHerbicide-resistant germplasms provide critical genetic resources for improving weed control and understanding resistance mechanisms in crops.ObjectiveTo screen sorghum accessions for tolerance to ACCase and ALS inhibitor herbicides at the seedling stage, identify the major locus and strong candidate gene associated with feproxydim resistance, and verify the gene expression pattern and genetic variation by quantitative real‑time PCR (qRT‑PCR) and KASP genotyping.

pmc-13201762.title: Linking tumor viability and immune infiltration with dual-nucleus MRI in preclinical models
pmc-13201762.creator: Sean W McRae, Jasmine H Lau, Francisco M Martinez, Jingchun Zhao, Corby Fink, John J Kelly, Ying Xia, Rafael E Sanchez Pupo, Paula J Foster, Timothy J Scholl, John A Ronald
pmc-13201762.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Immune activity within tumors and secondary lymphoid organs critically influences cancer progression, metastasis, and treatment response. We present a dual-nucleus (1H/19F) molecular MRI platform for non-invasive, high-resolution profiling of the tumor-immune microenvironment in immunocompetent mouse models. Tumor viability was visualized by engineering breast cancer cells to express a novel mouse-derived 1H MRI reporter gene, enabling in vivo differentiation of viable and necrotic tumor regions.

pmc-13300537.title: Single center experience with conduction system pacing in patients after transcatheter aortic valve implantation and atrioventricular conduction disturbances
pmc-13300537.creator: Z Som, Z Bari, C Foldesi, S Mladoniczky, D Pilecky, J Keszthelyi, L Kornyei, Z Nagy, A Kardos

pmc-13339524.description: BackgroundAvoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder (ARFID) is a possible comorbidity in patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). Early detection and intervention are crucial to prevent malnutrition and related complications. However, ARFID often remains undiagnosed due to its subtle presentation. Methods: This multicenter study enrolled 235 patients with IBD at German tertiary referral centers between March and September 2025.

pmc-13520748.title: Molecular Recycling of Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) Waste via Ytterbium Triflate-Catalyzed Hydrolysis
pmc-13520748.creator: Pouya Talaei, Phillip E. Savage
pmc-13520748.description: Returning waste polyethylene terephthalate (PET) to its original monomers (e.g., terephthalic acid (TPA)) constitutes closed-loop molecular recycling. Hydrolysis can accomplish this conversion and ytterbium triflate (Yb­(OTf)3) is an effective catalyst. PET hydrolysis with Yb­(OTf)3 at 220 °C for 40 min resulted in 92% PET conversion and 66% TPA yield, whereas the uncatalyzed reaction produced just 0.1% TPA yield.
